entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, you can help me by taking back this useless piece of junk you sold me. This VeloBand Pulse sensor is completely broken.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Is it a technical fault? It's defective! The thing is not working, period. It won't sync to my phone, the readings are nonsense. I want a refund, and I want it now. This is unacceptable.
I understand your frustration completely. I can see you received the VeloBand about a month ago. Let me just...

A month ago, a year ago, I don't care! It's broken! Are you going to give me my money back or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make sure no one ever buys this thing again.
That won't be necessary, sir. I can certainly handle this for you. I'm just pulling up your account and our return guidelines. One moment.
Hurry up. This is a waste of my time.

Okay, I've got it. I see here that you received the item 31 days ago. According to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since this device is defective, you are definitely eligible for a full refund.
Well, finally. See? That's all you had to say. So, what's next? Are you sending me a label?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the device, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Fine. Make sure that email comes through. That's all I needed.
You will receive it shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
